subject.title: feat(ui): let a link's slug settle a shared short-id prefix

question: Should a current display-name slug be part of the public short-session URL contract solely to resolve a complete ambiguous UUID-prefix match?
rationale: The patch is mechanically conservative, but it changes the previously decorative slug into an intentional secondary resolver in one observable compatibility case.

options.title: Confirm the narrow tie-breaker
options.body: Merge with the documented rule that a slug may choose exactly one session only after a complete short-ID collision lookup.

options.title: Keep slugs fully decorative
options.body: Retain chooser-only behavior for all short-ID collisions and close or revise this feature direction.

recommendation.title: Confirm the narrow tie-breaker
recommendation.body: Merge with the documented rule that a slug may choose exactly one session only after a complete short-ID collision lookup.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged and proposed work establishes the session-URL resolution design context.
